assumptions: Kinetic concentration reference stays at the source 1M EG condition when inlet EG is varied. The 298.15K reference is a room-temperature scenario assumption; temperature extrapolation is blocked until matched kinetic and transport data are supplied.

Validated default uses a native fully-developed Stokes-Poiseuille scalar velocity PDE, followed by transport/current coupling. It does not resolve entrance/manifold flow. An upstream straight section at least20mm is assumed; estimated laminar entrance length is~8mm for the baseline. General Navier-Stokes coupling remains experimental and failed conservation checks in early attempts.

Rectangular membrane-free planar channel 10mm x 10mm footprint, 1mm gap; area consistent with published flow cell; gap and rectangular internal details are design hypotheses, not reconstructed hardware.

Pd/NiMoO4/NF apparent anode anchor 100mA/cm2 at0.79VvsRHE and207.7mV/dec from Shi2024. Source curves have no iR compensation; applying them as a local boundary law is an apparent proxy and may double-count unseparated reference ohmic loss. Not intrinsic parameter identification.
EG order0.3 is a Pd|CCE literature-derived prior0.2-0.4 (Habibi2017), not measured on Pd/NiMoO4. No fitted OH order or activity; support electrolyte treated as reservoir.

GLY FE0.8 is an engineering approximation near the published ~0.8V window; unmeasured balance assigned FMA0.15/OX0.05 as carbon-conserving alternatives. This product spectrum is not a measurement. No sub-thermodynamic OER current is assigned.
Cathode HER anchor100mA/cm2 at0.12V overpotential, b0.12V/dec are kinetic scenario assumptions; source Ni foam cathode is not calibrated. Cell voltage is scenario-dependent.

rho1040kg/m3 andmu1.4mPa*s are adjusted water/EG reference hypotheses allowing for1MNaOH; conductivity17.6S/m is an adjacent aqueousNaOH reference at20C, transferred provisionally to EG electrolyte at25C; not measured mixture properties.

EG diffusivity estimated from Stokes-Einstein using298.15K,mu1.4mPa*s and molecular-volume radius~0.28nm derived from EG molar mass62.06784g/mol and pure-liquid rho1110.13kg/m3. Other diffusivities scaled by molecular-size hypotheses, not ionic measurements.
Steady laminar incompressible Newtonian single phase; no resolved bubbles, porous electrode interior, thermal gradients, adsorption or deactivation.

Secondary current approximation: constant supporting-electrolyte conductivity; ionic products tracked as passive dilute product scalars without electromigration. No claim of spatial K+/Na+/OH- conservation or tertiary electrochemical resolution.
Surface EG/GLY/FMA/OX fluxes use4/6/8electron balanced branches; cathode gas/HER rate from current. Constant density/volume; solvent and base depletion not spatially resolved.
2D per-depth channel and 3D finite-width no-slip channel are related but not identical; do not treat 3D span as automatic2D extrusion equivalence.
